challenges.headline: Undefined 'manager is away' trigger
challenges.premise: The request treats 'manager is away' as a single, obvious condition to detect.
challenges.alternative: It could mean an approved absence already recorded in the system (event-driven, reuses existing Absence data), or simply no response within N days (a timeout/scheduled job) — these are architecturally different builds, and the context explicitly warns this kind of rule often varies by team or country.
challenges.consequence: Building the wrong trigger either misses real absences (timeout-only) or fails when a manager is unavailable without a recorded absence (event-only), reproducing the exact stalling problem the feature is meant to fix.
challenges.recommendation: Get the client to define the trigger precisely — absence-driven, timeout-driven, or both — before estimating.

challenges.headline: Approval rights after escalation

challenges.recommendation: Decide explicitly whether escalation transfers or merely adds approval rights, and define the tie-break rule before implementation.
